title: Basic Examples

Basic Examples

This is a knowledge-topic node in the reductive linear algebraic groups DAG.

Scope

Topic collecting first examples such as additive groups, multiplicative groups, general linear groups, special linear groups, projective linear groups, orthogonal groups, symplectic groups, and finite group schemes when needed.

Role

This node may later be refined into definitions, examples, constructions, standard theorems, references, and finer statement-level nodes.
